verdict.rationale: Unleash documents self-hosting Open Source or Enterprise in your own environment, so you control where flag data is stored. Enterprise Edge keeps targeting PII on the Edge node rather than sending it to Unleash Cloud, and external metrics stay in your own Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics. However, there is no documented region or residency selection for the hosted cloud offering. Missing for 10: hosted-cloud region selection, explicit data-residency documentation or commitments, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: This guide helps you set up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment using Docker.
user data (PII) used for targeting rules (like user IDs, emails, or IPs) is processed within the Edge node and never sent to the Unleash Cloud or your upstream instance
External metrics are queried at read time from your existing Prometheus or VictoriaMetrics instance. The data stays in your system.
